goal: Give every PMCR-O phase (orchestrate/plan/make/check/reflect-and-seed) its own deterministic, zero-reasoning script -- mirroring pmcro-trail's New-Trail.ps1 -- so file mechanics are never hand-reasoned or write_file'd directly by an agent again.

steps.action: Author New-PlanFrame.ps1, New-MakeStep.ps1, New-CheckFrame.ps1, Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1, mirroring New-Trail.ps1's zero-reasoning, precondition-checked, reject-coded style.
Run the four scripts through a real end-to-end scratch-trail test, not just read them.
Fix whatever real bugs the test surfaces.
Re-test to confirm the fixes hold.
Author New-OrchestrateFrame.ps1 to close the same gap for Orchestrator, and test it as part of the full five-script loop.
Update every affected skill's run.*.asset.md, references/README.md, and SKILL.md to call the script instead of implying a hand-written file.
Rebuild and re-verify all six plugin zips; re-run claude plugin validate on the five affected plugins.
Confirm no run.*.asset.md across any of the five role plugins still describes writing a phase file directly by hand.

success_criteria: Each of orchestrate/plan/make/check/reflect-and-seed has its own deterministic script under its skill's scripts/
Every script's reject codes match its own reject.*.asset.md exactly
A real end-to-end run through all five scripts (mint, orchestrate, plan, make, check, reflect-and-seed) succeeds and produces schema-conformant JSONL
At least one real bug was found and fixed by actually running the scripts, not just by reading them
All five affected plugin zips rebuild clean and pass claude plugin validate
out_of_scope: Building a link-path script separate from New-Trail.ps1 (noted as a remaining gap, not closed this cycle)
